moments.title: A business journalist who did not understand her own money
moments.summary: The speaker says that even working as a business journalist she did not fully understand how to manage her money, and that nobody ever taught her what Nifty, PE ratios, SIPs or mutual funds meant.
moments.evidence: Even as a business journalist, I didn't fully understand how to manage my money.

moments.title: Why she created Investing for Mums
moments.summary: The speaker — who says in this clip that she created Investing for Mums — explains that intelligent women tune out of money conversations not because they are incapable but because nobody explained it in simple language, and describes the result as a safe space using games, analogies and everyday examples.
moments.evidence: We tune out of money conversations not because we're incapable, but nobody taught us these in simple language.

moments.title: Not about becoming a financial expert overnight
moments.summary: The closing statement: the aim is not to turn women into financial experts overnight but to build the confidence to slowly take charge of their financial future.
moments.evidence: This is not about turning women into financial experts overnight. It's about building the confidence to slowly take charge of your financial future.
